Priy yogi mitron, yah hath yog sury namaskar hai. jo aapko teji se vajan kam karne men madad karega, aapke sharir ko aakar men rakhega, aapka dhyan barhane men madad karega aur sath hi yaun vikaron ke lie bhi madadgar hoga. sabhi labh ek abhyas men paik hain to behtar parinamon ke lie kam se kam 3 raund tak abhyas karna sunishchit karen.
